notes: SHIP v1.14.392 - DETERMINISTIC RACK STAGE + EVENT-DRIVEN RECOVERY. THE DEVICE LOG WAS FROM A DIFFERENT SURFACE THAN THE ONE UNDER REPAIR, AND THAT MATTERED. The captured line "hero mount not laid out after 600f - will retry on next render" is emitted at dct-ios.html:21777 by cmd_rackHero3D, the COMMAND page hero at #cc-rackhero-mount. It is not the Build mount: bw_mount3D never uses a 600-frame budget and never says "hero", and its own failures print an on-card diagnostic naming #bw-mount. Acting on it as Build evidence would have meant rewriting the Build stage against a measurement taken from another component. Recorded because the same mistake is easy to repeat. WHAT IT DID PROVE, AND IT IS THE REAL DEFECT CLASS: a rack mount can reach the renderer while measuring zero, and the recovery contract was "will retry on next render" - which is not a contract at all. With no state mutation there is no next render, so the surface stays blank permanently. The owner identified this precisely. With a Master confirmed loaded on the device, the Command hero is not hidden, so it genuinely fails to lay out - the same class of failure Build shows. TWO CORRECTIONS, BOTH DETERMINISTIC, NEITHER DEPENDENT ON DIAGNOSING WHY THE BOX WAS ZERO. (1) THE STAGE OWNS ITS OWN SIZE. The mount was a fixed height:268px, and a fixed height still measures zero when an ancestor collapses - which is exactly what the log proved happens. It is now position:relative, width:100%, min-height:320px, aspect-ratio:4/3, overflow:hidden, contain:layout. min-height and aspect-ratio give the box intrinsic size that does not wait on the parent chain resolving, and contain:layout stops a zero-height ancestor from starving it. Desktop steps to 340px and full desktop to 420px through the same min-height rather than competing fixed heights. (2) RECOVERY IS EVENT-DRIVEN, NOT RENDER-DRIVEN. A ResizeObserver now watches the mount and fires the moment the box becomes measurable, whatever finally gave it size, so recovery never again waits on an unrelated future render. The bounded rAF pass is kept only as a fast path for the common case where layout is a frame or two behind; when it is exhausted the code hands off to the observer and WAITS rather than declaring failure. A terminal error is now reported only when ResizeObserver itself is unavailable. VERIFIED BY INTERACTION AT 393: computed min-height 320px, aspect-ratio 4/3, contain layout, mount measures 330x320, canvas present, no diagnostic shown, zero horizontal overflow. SCENE UNTOUCHED - lighting, materials, geometry, fog, camera direction, floor, reflection, tone mapping, tray geometry and TYPE_COLORS are exactly as they were. This is a host-layout and lifecycle correction only, as directed. STILL OPEN AND DISCLOSED: cmd_rackHero3D on the Command page still carries the original 600-frame spin and the same weak retry-on-next-render contract; it needs the identical ResizeObserver treatment and is the next ship, kept separate because it is a different surface and bundling it would repeat the mistake this ship documents. Also open: the bottom nav fourth item is EXIT where the approved reference shows SHIFT, the rack control rail wraps 4-then-1 and carries REAR and EXPLODE which the reference does not show, and the metrics layout has still not been visually verified against a Master-linked rack. DEVICE-VERIFY: cold load, open Build, confirm the rack draws on the FIRST open with no interaction; leave to Command and return; complete a phase; confirm it draws every time. If it ever fails the card names the exact stop point.
